heading: Get to Work
sub: What happens after your WIL placement and graduation.
seo_title: Get to Work — Pioneer Technical Institute, Iganga Uganda
seo_description: How Pioneer Technical Institute graduates move from Work-Integrated Learning placement into employment or self-employment.
seo_keywords: PTI graduate employment, get to work Pioneer Technical Institute, vocational graduate jobs Uganda

sections.heading: From Placement to Employment
sections.body: Many WIL host employers go on to formally employ the trainees they hosted, since they've already seen their work firsthand. Where that doesn't happen, your industrial testimonial and production-unit portfolio are strong evidence of real experience for other employers.

sections.heading: Self-Employment
sections.body: A large share of PTI graduates go on to start their own workshops, shops, or service businesses. Because you've already worked on real paying jobs in PTI's production unit, you graduate with more than a certificate — you graduate with a track record.

sections.heading: Continued Study
sections.body: Graduates who want to keep progressing can move from National Certificate into a Diploma or Bachelor's degree with a partner institution — see each course's page for its specific progression pathway.
